content.text:
I submitted **index 18 (Mn 0.51 / Y 0.49)** as the best composition. It gave the highest photocurrent I measured, 1.6×10⁻⁷ A. That puts it at the YMnO3 ratio.

All 3 merit measurements are used:

| Index | Mn fraction | Photocurrent (A) |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | 0.79 | 1×10⁻⁸ |
| 18 | 0.51 | **1.6×10⁻⁷** |
| 10 | 0.41 | 8×10⁻⁸ |

Photocurrent peaks near Mn 0.5 and falls on both sides, most steeply toward the Mn-rich end.

**Limits:**
- **XRD didn't help.** I used 4 of the 5 XRD measurements (indices 18, 10, 23 and 3). Each showed one peak at about Q = 2.78 Å⁻¹, so I couldn't match phases to compositions.
- **Gaps remain.** Nothing between Mn 0.51 and 0.79 was measured, and nothing below Mn 0.41. The true best could be a nearby composition I didn't measure, such as index 14 (Mn 0.53) or index 13 (Mn 0.56).
